subject: general
question: Who among the following is the author of the book titled ‘Fasting, Feasting’?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Anita Desai.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** 

__
 
• Fasting, Feasting is a novel by Indian writer Anita Desai, first **published in 1999 **in **Great Britain by Chatto & Windus.**
 
• It was **shortlisted **for the** Booker Prize for fiction in 1999.**
 
• It metaphorically represents the life experiences of the two main characters, **Uma **and **Arun**, in their respective cultural contexts.
 
• Uma's 'fasting' signifies the denial and deprivation in her life in India, where her opportunities and personal desires are suppressed in fulfillment of family obligations.
 
• In contrast, Arun's 'feasting' underscores his experiences in America, where he encounters a different realm of excess and indulgence.
 
• This novel of intricate family relations plays out in two countries, India and the United States.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anita Desai**

 
 
• She is an Indian novelist.
 
• Her books include
 
 
• **Clear Light of Day** (1980),
 
• **In Custody **(1984) and
 
• **Fasting**, **Feasting **(1999) among many.
